Bihar Bureaucracy : bihar men sarkari yojnaon ke udghatan aur shilanyas ko lekar mukhy sachiv pratyay amrit ne adhikariyon ko sakht nirdesh jari kie hain... aadesh ke mutabik, prashasnik adhikari vikas yojnaon ka udghatan nahin karenge aur yojnaon ke shilapatt par unka nam bhi ankit nahin kiya jaega... sarkari karyakramon men sthaniy sansad, vidhayak aur vidhan parshadon ko anivary rup se aamantrit karna hoga... unke lie sammanajnak baithak vyavastha aur nirdharit protokol ka palan bhi sunishchit karna hoga
